name: linear
title: Linear
description: Editable Linear ingestion with nine independent raw resource streams, overlapping update windows, and complete issue history.

changes: Sync issues, comments, projects, project updates, cycles, users, and teams through independent overlapping updated-time windows, including archived and disabled resources.
Add independent full-sync streams for issue relations and issue history; discover and paginate history for all accessible issues without relying on parent stream progress or modification times.
Store each resource in its own raw table with provider IDs and relationship references; retain complete issue labels as strings and leave joins and metrics to ClickHouse.
Use shared pagination, validated GraphQL responses, request-level retries and sink-acknowledged completion checkpoints; separate configuration, injectable requests, readers, and pipeline wiring.
Existing issue IDs remain stable; migrate retained nested comment observations deliberately and populate the eight new destinations through their own initial syncs.
Consume the ingestion plugin's full pagination pages, preserving continuations and empty terminal pages with independent resource checkpoints.

resources.name: issues
resources.title: Issues
resources.description: Archived and active issue fields, relationship IDs, and fully paginated label names as strings.

resources.name: comments
resources.title: Comments
resources.description: Raw comments selected by their own update times, with nullable issue and other parent references.

resources.name: projects
resources.title: Projects
resources.description: Project metadata and provider relationship references selected by project update times.

resources.name: project_updates
resources.title: Project updates
resources.description: Authored progress and health updates with project and author references.

resources.name: cycles
resources.title: Cycles
resources.description: Cycle dates, descriptions, and team references selected by cycle update times.

resources.name: users
resources.title: Users
resources.description: Accessible user metadata, including disabled users, selected by user update times.

resources.name: teams
resources.title: Teams
resources.description: Accessible team metadata selected by team update times.

resources.name: issue_relations
resources.title: Issue relations
resources.description: Complete accessible relation records with type and both directed issue references; no reliable root change filter exists.

resources.name: issue_history
resources.title: Issue history
resources.description: Complete accessible history for independently discovered issues; the parent history connection has no timestamp filter.

setup: Provide LINEAR_API_KEY with read access to the selected resources.
Keep the API key in the runtime environment and rotate it according to the provider policy.

sync.description: One workspace pipeline groups nine independent raw streams. Seven resources use bounded updatedAt windows with five-minute overlap; issue relations and history use fullSync. Each stream completes only after destination acknowledgement.
sync.schedule: Run bunx chkit ingest run --tag provider:linear from a scheduler.
sync.deletions: Deleted records and removed relations remain stored; absence is not a tombstone. Comments have their own update windows. Periodic reconciliation refreshes older observations and label renames beyond the issue overlap; retained legacy nested comments require deliberate migration.
